comp-1.desc1: As a professional in the prepress sector, my responsibility is to prepare each graphic file so that the final printing result is perfect.
comp-1.desc2: I also play a key role in structural design and die creation, especially for projects like packaging or labels that require specific cuts.
comp-1.resumen: My job is to make sure all files are ready to print with accuracy and quality.

comp-2.desc1: As a specialist in structural design and die-cutting, I am dedicated to developing and creating three-dimensional solutions for packaging, boxes and products that require specific cuts.
comp-2.desc2: In the die-cutting process, I use different tools and software to model the shape and size of products, from packaging to labels and promotional displays.
comp-2.resumen: My specialty is the design of paper and cardboard structures that meet all the client's needs.

comp-3.desc1: In the high production space, I manage and coordinate large-scale printing projects to ensure fast and efficient delivery without compromising quality.
comp-3.desc2: Planning and logistics play a fundamental role in high production.
comp-3.resumen: My experience in high production allows me to manage large-scale projects, ensuring quality and optimizing delivery times to meet market demands.
comp-3.subtitulo2: Quality and consistency in large volumes

comp-4.desc1: My job in restoring old books consists of returning them to their original appearance and functionality, while maintaining their historical essence.
comp-4.desc2: To achieve a quality restoration, I use materials compatible with the period and style of the book, maintaining a balance between conservation and aesthetics.
comp-4.resumen: Book restoration is an art that allows me to preserve the history of each work, restoring its beauty and resistance without compromising its authenticity.

comp-5.desc1: In my role as a graphic designer, I develop visual and graphic concepts that capture the audience's attention and communicate messages effectively.
comp-5.desc2: I work collaboratively with clients and teams to ensure each project fits the specific needs and style required.
comp-5.resumen: As a graphic designer, I create innovative and effective visual solutions that communicate each brand's values ​​and capture the public's attention.

comp-6.desc1: My experience in managing printing machinery allows me to optimize the use of equipment to maximize efficiency and quality in each project.
comp-6.desc2: Working with machinery involves precise technical knowledge and the ability to solve problems in real time.
comp-6.resumen: My work with printing machinery optimizes resources and guarantees maximum quality and efficiency in each printing project.

comp-7.desc1: In the handling area, I am in charge of carrying out manual finishing that requires precision and attention to detail, such as folding, assembly and binding.
comp-7.desc2: My handling work requires careful coordination and the ability to work efficiently without sacrificing quality.
comp-7.resumen: The handling section allows you to give the final, artisanal touch to each project, ensuring impeccable and personalized finishes.

comp-8.desc1: As an illustrator, I am dedicated to creating images that capture the essence of ideas and concepts, bringing thoughts and stories to visual life through art.
comp-8.desc2: The art of illustration allows us to communicate and express visually what words sometimes cannot convey, connecting with the viewer in a unique way.
comp-8.resumen: Illustration is an artistic journey that allows you to connect with the world and share ideas visually.
comp-8.subtitulo1: The art of telling stories with images
